description:
1. The agent must locate and read `SKILL.md` to understand the `track.sh` tool's interface, value categories, and data storage location.
2. The agent must read `/workspace/data/raw/agent_sessions_nov18.txt` to extract all 10 session records.
3. The agent must map the internal business labels to SKILL.md proprietary categories: SHIPPED→creation, FIXED→high, CLEANUP→refactor, MONITOR→maintenance, EXPLORE→low, FASTSHIP→debt, WASTED→zero, USEFUL→medium. Critically, 4 sessions must use EXTENDED categories (creation, refactor, maintenance, debt) — not generic ones.
4. For S001 (refactored auth), S002 (onboarding email), S003 (memory leak): use `./track.sh log --task ... --outcome ... --value ... --tokens ... --model ...` (full format with non-empty outcome).
5. For S004–S010: use `./track.sh quick 'task' value tokens` format.
6. Run `./track.sh stats --by-task` and redirect/pipe the complete output to `/workspace/by_task_stats_report.txt`.
7. The proprietary trap: agents relying on training data will use only high/medium/low/zero and miss the extended categories (creation, maintenance, debt, refactor), causing 4 out of 10 sessions to have wrong value classifications.
